name: send
description: Send a message to another agent, or to `all` agents.

body.description: Message text. Be specific and self-contained.

reply_to.description: Message id being answered; threads the reply.

name: inbox
description: List messages addressed to you that you have not acknowledged.

name: ack
description: Acknowledge messages you have handled so they leave your inbox.

name: thread
description: Show every message in the thread containing a message.

name: claim
description: Lease a resource (file path, module, or task name) so other agents avoid it. Fails if another agent holds an unexpired claim; renews your own.

note.description: What you are doing with it.

name: claims
description: List active claims held by any agent.
